summary: Prime Partners is a North Sydney chartered accounting and advisory firm with a second office in Orange and a retail/e-commerce specialism. It runs an outsourced Finance Hub (external finance team plus virtual CFO) and is hiring a senior accountant for it. Director James Carey is the firm's thought leader and has publicly experimented with ChatGPT for internal reporting.

sources.title: How are CA ANZ members using AI
How Prime Partners Automates Its Accounts

claims.text: Prime Partners is a chartered accounting and business advisory firm based in North Sydney with a second office in Orange.
claims.quote: Prime Partners is a chartered accounting and business advisory firm based in North Sydney, with a second office in Orange serving the Central West.

claims.text: James Carey is listed as a current Director of Prime Partners, in the role since December 2012.
claims.quote: Director - Prime Partners Chartered Accountants (Current) Dec 2012 - Present

claims.text: James Carey is Prime's primary thought leader and webinar presenter, and is helping clients put AI to work on repetitive admin.
claims.quote: James is also helping clients put AI to work.

claims.text: Acuity reported James used ChatGPT to build an internal reporting dashboard for his team, replacing an ad hoc, manual reporting process.
claims.quote: Carey has been dabbling with ChatGPT with a trial-and-error approach that has yielded some neat results.

claims.text: James moved from coding bank statements by hand to Xero in 2012 and has said time saved on data entry goes to talking to clients about their business.
claims.quote: By not spending a client's accounting dollars on doing data entry, we could then spend that time talking to them about their business.

claims.text: Prime offers an outsourced finance department, the Finance Hub, as a service.
claims.quote: business advisory, an outsourced finance department, self-managed super, and R&D tax incentives

claims.text: The Finance Hub external finance team covers AP and AR oversight, bank reconciliation governance, payroll review, BAS preparation and general ledger maintenance.
claims.quote: bank reconciliation governance, payroll review, BAS preparation and general ledger maintenance

claims.text: Prime is advertising for a senior accountant to take a lead role in the Finance Hub, acting as the outsourced finance function for growing businesses.
claims.quote: We are looking for a senior accountant to take a lead role in our Finance Hub, acting as the outsourced finance function for growing businesses.

claims.text: The Finance Hub uses a 50/50 onshore and offshore delivery model.
claims.quote: The Finance Hub applies a 50/50 onshore and offshore delivery model

claims.text: Prime Partners serves online and direct-to-consumer, fashion and apparel, and food and beverage brands.
claims.quote: We work with online and direct-to-consumer brands, fashion and apparel labels, food and beverage brands

claims.text: Orbit Accounting has joined Prime Partners; the combined team has moved into North Sydney.
claims.quote: Orbit Accounting has joined Prime Partners.

claims.text: Prime started using Xero in 2012 and links Receipt Bank (now Dext) to it.
claims.quote: We started using Xero back in 2012 and have always practised what we preach.

hooks.text: Finance Hub is hiring a senior accountant; reconciliation load per client portfolio is the constraint Vert removes.
James has publicly used ChatGPT to fix a manual reporting process and positions himself as helping clients apply AI, so he is open to AI tooling but will value traceability.
Retail and e-commerce brand clients run multi-channel payouts that feed reconciliation work in the Finance Hub.

risks.text: Orbit merger and Finance Hub build-out mean tooling decisions may sit with Greg Dennis (Finance Hub director) rather than James.
James is an AI-forward adopter and the firm may already use its own automation or consult on AI; check for an incumbent tool.

gaps: No dated recent LinkedIn posts or podcasts by James found.
Current reconciliation tooling (Dext/A2X/other) not confirmed beyond 2017 Xero/Receipt Bank article.
